bibliographic.title: Rougi
bibliographic.author: Lapin Lunaire Games
bibliographic.description:
The Palais Garnier, home to the renowned Paris Opéra Ballet, is set to premiere Les Souliers Rouges, a ballet whose very name is rumored to carry a formidable curse. As the premiere draws ever nearer, a series of inexplicable incidents in the opera house stir up a maelstrom of terror and intrigue. With whispers of illicit affairs, sinister motives, and hauntings around every corner, tensions—and the stakes—have never been higher. Here, everyone has a part to play…and everyone is playing a part.
Delve through rumour and reason into the glittering Belle Époque world of the Paris Opéra Ballet and unravel what’s really going on in the wings. After all, the show must go on…

Features
Hunt for clues to untangle the web connecting the enigmatic cast and company of the BalletExplore Belle Époque Paris with a fully customizable character: select your own name, gender, and pronouns, as well as one of three unique social statusesUnlock achievements by exploring branching story pathsChange the course of the story with your choicesDiscover the story of the fabled curse rumoured to haunt the very name of Les Souliers Rouges


Credits & Contact
Written and coded by LapinLunaireGames for the @interact-if unranked game jam. For updates and bonus content, please visit the development blog.
